entries.text: Contributor tooling: `make pr-preflight` now runs its mapped tests under the host lock, admission check and watchdog, so preflights from several sessions queue instead of running together. A pull request that changes only documents read by recorded tests, such as a `docs/agent` page, no longer runs the full heavy CI tier: the reader index now finds documents that tests reach through a glob in a module they import, and CI runs those reader tests instead. The primary-clone report also warns when git-ignored mirrored skills, such as `.claude/skills/blog`, differ from the pinned manifest.
